findings.current: Jin Mukyung pulled his sword from the enemy’s chest, muffling a groan.
findings.defect: The draft makes Mukyung the one muffling a groan; the enemy groans.
findings.rationale: 억눌린 신음을 토해 내는 modifies 적.
findings.replacement: Jin Mukyung pulled his sword from the chest of the enemy who had let out the stifled groan.
findings.source: 진무경은 억눌린 신음을 토해 내는 적의 가슴에서 검을 뽑아냈다.

findings.defect: The thought asserts sight just before the narration says he can sense things without seeing them.
findings.rationale: 선명하다 describes clarity without specifying visual perception.

findings.current: “You know it. The Great Hero here knows it, and so do you. What the best choice is.”
findings.defect: Wipeng’s statement that he knows the best choice is replaced with a second reference to Mukyung.
findings.rationale: 나도 refers to Wipeng, followed by Cheol Mubaek and Mukyung.
findings.replacement: “I know it, Great Hero Cheol here knows it, and you know it yourself. What the best choice is.”
findings.source: “나도, 여기 계신 철 대협께서도, 그리고 너 스스로도 알 것이다. 무엇이 최선인지는.”

findings.current: “Leave before it’s too late. We can still break through and open a way out.”
findings.defect: “We” includes Wipeng in the escape, contradicting his insistence that Mukyung go alone.
findings.rationale: The preceding 너 혼자서라면 establishes Mukyung alone as the person who can escape.
findings.replacement: “Leave before it’s too late. You can still break through and make your escape.”
findings.source: “더 늦기 전에 떠나라. 지금이라면 충분히 퇴로를 뚫을 수 있을 거다.”

findings.current: “Damn it. I’ve spat out a few *doe* of blood already, and now I can barely manage a handful.”
findings.defect: The untranslated measure obscures the contrast between a large amount of blood and a handful.
findings.rationale: 몇 됫박 conveys an emphatically large quantity; the joke depends on its contrast with 한 줌.
findings.replacement: “Damn it. I’ve coughed up bucketfuls of blood, and now all I can manage is a handful.”
findings.source: “젠장. 피만 몇 됫박을 쏟았더니 이제는 고작해야 한 줌이구먼.”

findings.current: Remembering the old fiend who had become the first prey of his nameless strike, Jin Mukyung stepped toward the frozen enemies.
findings.defect: The draft omits the technique name placed immediately before this recollection.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly names 청파낙조 here, changing the strike from nameless to named.
findings.replacement:
*Blue Wave, Falling Bird.*

Remembering the old fiend who had become the first prey of that once-nameless strike, Jin Mukyung stepped toward the frozen enemies.
findings.source:
청파낙조(靑波落鳥).

이름 없던 일격의 첫 먹잇감이 된 늙은 마두를 떠올리며

findings.current: The owner of the unfamiliar voice that had suddenly spoken stood just ten steps away, looking at him.
findings.defect: Ten steps changes the specified distance of one jang.
findings.rationale: 일장 is a distance of roughly three meters, not ten steps.
findings.replacement: The owner of the unfamiliar voice that had suddenly spoken stood only about ten feet away, looking at him.
findings.source: 불과 일장밖에 되지 않는 거리에서 그를 바라보고 있었다.

summary: Several action and speaker errors need correction, along with an omitted technique name.
